full_judgment: 23. Regarding possession in the suit land i.e. land of plot No.1208 the plaintiff (In Title Suit No.74 of 1993) examined four witnesses. P.Ws.1, 2, 3 and 5 deposed sup-porting the possession of the plaintiff in the suit land. Although those witnesses were cross-examined by the defendants No.3 and 4, but no contradiction had been made. Moreover, Exhibit-4 (D.P. Khatian) shows that Katanmoni Nath had the possession in respect of the land of plot No.1208.
